Account
  [apiKey]
  [chatgpt]
    email: string | null
    planType: PlanType
  [amazonBedrock]
    usesCodexManagedCredentials?: boolean

AccountRateLimitsUpdatedNotification
  // Sparse rolling rate-limit update. Clients should merge available values into the most recent `account/rateLimits/read` response or refetch that snapshot. Nullable account metadata may be unavailable in a rolling update and does not clear a previously observed value.
  rateLimits: RateLimitSnapshot

ApplyPatchApprovalResponse
  decision: ReviewDecision

AskForApproval
  | "untrusted"
  | "on-request"
  | "never"
  | { granular: { mcp_elicitations: boolean; request_permissions?: boolean; rules: boolean; sandbox_approval: boolean; skill_approval?: boolean } }

ClientInfo
  name: string
  title?: string | null
  version: string

CodexErrorInfo
  // This translation layer make sure that we expose codex error code in camel case. When an upstream HTTP status is available (for example, from the Responses API or a provider), it is forwarded in `httpStatusCode` on the relevant `codexErrorInfo` variant.
  | "contextWindowExceeded"
  | "sessionBudgetExceeded"
  | "usageLimitExceeded"
  | "rateLimitExceeded"
  | "flexUnavailable"
  | "serverOverloaded"
  | "cyberPolicy"
  | "misalignmentPolicyViolation"
  | "tooManyDenials"
  | "internalServerError"
  | "unauthorized"
  | "badRequest"
  | "threadRollbackFailed"
  | "sandboxError"
  | "other"
  | { httpConnectionFailed: { httpStatusCode?: integer | null } }
  | { responseStreamConnectionFailed: { httpStatusCode?: integer | null } }
    // Failed to connect to the response SSE stream.
  | { responseStreamDisconnected: { httpStatusCode?: integer | null } }
    // The response SSE stream disconnected in the middle of a turn before completion.
  | { responseTooManyFailedAttempts: { httpStatusCode?: integer | null } }
    // Reached the retry limit for responses.
  | { activeTurnNotSteerable: { turnKind: NonSteerableTurnKind } }
    // Returned when `turn/start` or `turn/steer` is submitted while the current active turn cannot accept same-turn steering, for example `/review` or manual `/compact`.
  | string | object

CommandAction
  [read]
    command: string
    name: string
    path: LegacyAppPathString
  [listFiles]
    command: string
    path?: string | null
  [search]
    command: string
    path?: string | null
    query?: string | null
  [unknown]
    command: string

CommandExecutionRequestApprovalResponse
  decision: CommandExecutionApprovalDecision

CreditsSnapshot
  balance?: string | null
  hasCredits: boolean
  unlimited: boolean

ErrorNotification
  error: TurnError
  threadId: string
  turnId: string
  willRetry: boolean

ExecCommandApprovalResponse
  decision: ReviewDecision

FileChangeRequestApprovalResponse
  decision: FileChangeApprovalDecision

GetAccountParams
  refreshToken?: boolean
      // When `true`, requests a proactive token refresh before returning. In managed auth mode this triggers the normal refresh-token flow. In external auth mode this flag is ignored. Clients should refresh tokens themselves and call `account/login/start` with `chatgptAuthTokens`.

GetAccountRateLimitsParams
  // Usage-read capabilities of the requesting client, never inferred from its experiment arm.
  excludeResetCreditDetails?: boolean
      // Skip the separate reset-credit detail lookup for background usage polls. The usage response still includes the available count; omitted/false preserves detailed reads.
  supportsLunaReserve?: boolean
      // The client supports automatic Luna Reserve fallback. For eligible ChatGPT CLI users, allow the backend to record experiment exposure after ordinary usage is blocked.

GetAccountRateLimitsResponse
  accountId?: string | null
      // Account associated with this usage snapshot, when supplied by the backend.
  ordinaryUsageAllowed?: boolean | null
      // Backend permission for ordinary included usage, validated against the active account. Null means unavailable; clients must not infer recovery from percentages or reset times.
  rateLimitResetCredits?: RateLimitResetCreditsSummary | null
  rateLimitUpsell?: unknown
      // Optional backend-owned banner from the same usage read. Its nested keys retain the backend's snake_case contract; an absent banner leaves the client's existing UI unchanged.
  rateLimits: RateLimitSnapshot
      // Backward-compatible single-bucket view; mirrors the historical payload.
  rateLimitsByLimitId?: Record<string, RateLimitSnapshot> | null
      // Multi-bucket view keyed by metered `limit_id` (for example, `codex`).

GetAccountResponse
  account?: Account | null
  requiresOpenaiAuth: boolean
  workspaceRouting?: WorkspaceRouting | null

InitializeCapabilities
  // Client-declared capabilities negotiated during initialize.
  experimentalApi?: boolean
      // Opt into receiving experimental API methods and fields.
  explicitGatewayOauth?: boolean
      // Use explicit gateway OAuth login instead of automatic browser authorization. Applies to this app-server's gateway runtime; later connections cannot undo it.
  extensions?: object | null
      // MCP extension settings declared by the app-server client.
  mcpServerOpenaiFormElicitation?: boolean
      // Legacy opt-in for the `openai/form` MCP extension. New clients should declare `openai/form` in [`Self::extensions`].
  optOutNotificationMethods?: Array<string> | null
      // Exact notification method names that should be suppressed for this connection (for example `thread/started`).
  requestAttestation?: boolean
      // Opt into `attestation/generate` requests for upstream `x-oai-attestation`.

InitializeParams
  capabilities?: InitializeCapabilities | null
  clientInfo: ClientInfo

InitializeResponse
  codexHome: AbsolutePathBuf
      // Absolute path to the server's $CODEX_HOME directory.
  platformFamily: string
      // Platform family for the running app-server target, for example `"unix"` or `"windows"`.
  platformOs: string
      // Operating system for the running app-server target, for example `"macos"`, `"linux"`, or `"windows"`.
  userAgent: string

ItemCompletedNotification
  completedAtMs: integer
      // Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) when this item lifecycle completed.
  item: ThreadItem
  threadId: string
  turnId: string

ItemStartedNotification
  item: ThreadItem
  startedAtMs: integer
      // Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) when this item lifecycle started.
  threadId: string
  turnId: string

McpServerElicitationRequestResponse
  _meta?: unknown
      // Optional client metadata for form-mode action handling.
  action: McpServerElicitationAction
  content?: unknown
      // Structured user input for accepted elicitations, mirroring RMCP `CreateElicitationResult`. This is nullable because decline/cancel responses have no content.

MessagePhase
  // Classifies assistant text as commentary, a partial answer, or a terminal answer. Providers do not emit this consistently, so callers must treat `None` as "phase unknown" and keep compatibility behavior for legacy models.
  | "commentary"
  | "partial_answer"
  | "final_answer"

RateLimitSnapshot
  credits?: CreditsSnapshot | null
  individualLimit?: SpendControlLimitSnapshot | null
  limitId?: string | null
  limitName?: string | null
  normalModelSlug?: string | null
      // Normal model whose display name and reasoning options describe this quota alias.
  planType?: PlanType | null
  primary?: RateLimitWindow | null
  rateLimitReachedType?: RateLimitReachedType | null
  secondary?: RateLimitWindow | null
  spendControlReached?: boolean | null
      // Backend-reported spend-control state. `None` is unavailable, not a sparse-update recovery.

RateLimitWindow
  resetsAt?: integer | null
  usedPercent: integer
  windowDurationMins?: integer | null

ReasoningEffort
  // A non-empty reasoning effort value advertised by the model.
  = string

SandboxMode
  | "read-only"
  | "workspace-write"
  | "danger-full-access"

SortDirection
  | "asc"
  | "desc"

Thread
  agentNickname?: string | null
      // Optional random unique nickname assigned to an AgentControl-spawned sub-agent.
  agentRole?: string | null
      // Optional role (agent_role) assigned to an AgentControl-spawned sub-agent.
  canAcceptDirectInput?: boolean | null
      // Whether the app server accepts direct turn input for this loaded thread. `None` means the capability is unavailable, such as for an unloaded stored thread.
  cliVersion: string
      // Version of the CLI that created the thread.
  createdAt: integer
      // Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the thread was created.
  cwd: AbsolutePathBuf
      // Working directory captured for the thread.
  daybreakEnabled?: boolean | null
      // Saved Daybreak choice, independent of turn execution. Null if unset.
  environments?: Array<ThreadEnvironment> | null
      // Current environments for a loaded thread, in priority order, primary first. `null` means the thread is not loaded or the server does not expose its selection. An empty list means no environments are selected. This does not report connection status.
  ephemeral: boolean
      // Whether the thread is ephemeral and should not be materialized on disk.
  extra?: ThreadExtra | null
      // Optional implementation-specific thread data.
  forkedFromId?: string | null
      // Source thread id when this thread was created by forking another thread.
  gitInfo?: GitInfo | null
      // Optional Git metadata captured when the thread was created.
  historyMode?: ThreadHistoryMode
      // Persisted thread history contract selected when this thread was created.
  id: string
      // Identifier for this thread. Codex-generated thread IDs are UUIDv7.
  model?: string | null
      // Current configured model when loaded, otherwise the latest persisted model. Null when unavailable. This is not per-turn execution telemetry.
  modelProvider: string
      // Model provider used for this thread (for example, 'openai').
  name?: string | null
      // Optional user-facing thread title.
  originator?: string | null
      // Originator recorded when the thread was created, independent of its current client or executor. Null when the recorded originator is unavailable.
  parentThreadId?: string | null
      // The ID of the parent thread. This will only be set if this thread is a subagent.
  path?: string | null
      // [UNSTABLE] Path to the thread on disk.
  preview: string
      // Usually the first user message in the thread, if available.
  projectId: string | null
      // Canonical project assignment owned by app-server, if any.
  reasoningEffort?: ReasoningEffort | null
      // Current configured reasoning effort when loaded, otherwise the latest persisted effort. Null when unset or unavailable. This is not per-turn execution telemetry.
  recencyAt?: integer | null
      // Unix timestamp (in seconds) used for thread recency ordering.
  section?: ThreadSection | null
      // The independently persisted section selected for this thread, if any.
  sectionEnteredAt?: integer | null
      // Unix timestamp in seconds when the thread entered its current section.
  sessionId: string
      // Session id shared by threads that belong to the same session tree.
  source: SessionSource
      // Origin of the thread (CLI, VSCode, codex exec, codex app-server, etc.).
  status: ThreadStatus
      // Current runtime status for the thread.
  threadSource?: ThreadSource | null
      // Optional analytics source classification for this thread.
  turns: Array<Turn>
      // Only populated on `thread/resume`, `thread/fork`, and `thread/read` (when `includeTurns` is true) responses. For all other responses and notifications returning a Thread, the turns field will be an empty list.
  updatedAt: integer
      // Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the thread was last updated.

ThreadBackgroundTerminal
  command: string
  cpuPercent?: number | null
  cwd: LegacyAppPathString
  itemId: string
  osPid?: integer | null
  processId: string
  rssKb?: integer | null

ThreadBackgroundTerminalsListParams
  cursor?: string | null
      // Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.
  limit?: integer | null
      // Optional page size.
  threadId: string

ThreadBackgroundTerminalsListResponse
  data: Array<ThreadBackgroundTerminal>
  nextCursor?: string | null
      // Opaque cursor to pass to the next call to continue after the last item. If None, there are no more items to return.

ThreadBackgroundTerminalsTerminateParams
  processId: string
  threadId: string

ThreadBackgroundTerminalsTerminateResponse
  terminated: boolean

ThreadItem
  [userMessage]
    clientId?: string | null
    content: Array<UserInput>
    id: string
  [hookPrompt]
    fragments: Array<HookPromptFragment>
    id: string
  [agentMessage]
    delivery?: AgentMessageDelivery | null
    id: string
    memoryCitation?: MemoryCitation | null
    phase?: MessagePhase | null
    questions?: Array<AsyncUserInputQuestion> | null
    text: string
  [functionCallOutput]
    id: string
    name: string
    namespace?: string | null
    output: FunctionCallOutputBody
  [plan]
    // EXPERIMENTAL - proposed plan item content. The completed plan item is authoritative and may not match the concatenation of `PlanDelta` text.
    id: string
    text: string
  [reasoning]
    content?: Array<string>
    id: string
    summary?: Array<string>
  [commandExecution]
    aggregatedOutput?: string | null
        // The command's output, aggregated from stdout and stderr.
    command: string
        // The command to be executed.
    commandActions: Array<CommandAction>
        // A best-effort parsing of the command to understand the action(s) it will perform. This returns a list of CommandAction objects because a single shell command may be composed of many commands piped together.
    cwd: LegacyAppPathString
        // The command's working directory.
    durationMs?: integer | null
        // The duration of the command execution in milliseconds.
    exitCode?: integer | null
        // The command's exit code.
    id: string
    pluginId?: string | null
        // Trusted first-party plugin id when this command resolves to one plugin script.
    processId?: string | null
        // Identifier for the underlying PTY process (when available).

ThreadResumeParams
  // There are three ways to resume a thread: 1. By thread_id: load the thread from disk by thread_id and resume it. 2. By history: instantiate the thread from memory and resume it. 3. By path: load the thread from disk by path and resume it. For non-running threads, the precedence is: history > non-empty path > thread_id. If using history or a non-empty path for a non-running thread, the thread_id param will be ignored. If thread_id identifies a running thread, app-server rejoins that thread and treats a non-empty path as a consistency check against the active rollout path. Empty string path values are treated as absent. Prefer using thread_id whenever possible.
  approvalPolicy?: AskForApproval | null
  approvalsReviewer?: ApprovalsReviewer | null
      // Override where approval requests are routed for review on this thread and subsequent turns.
  baseInstructions?: string | null
  config?: object | null
  cwd?: string | null
  developerInstructions?: string | null
  excludeTurns?: boolean
      // When true, return only thread metadata and live-resume state without populating `thread.turns`. This is useful when the client plans to call `thread/turns/list` immediately after resuming. Full-history hydration is deprecated for paginated threads; use this with `thread/turns/list` and `thread/items/list` instead.
  history?: Array<ResponseItem> | null
      // [UNSTABLE] FOR CODEX CLOUD - DO NOT USE. If specified, the thread will be resumed with the provided history instead of loaded from disk.
  initialTurnsPage?: ThreadResumeInitialTurnsPageParams | null
      // When present, include a `thread/turns/list` page in the resume response so clients can bootstrap recent turns without a second request.
  model?: string | null
      // Configuration overrides for the resumed thread, if any.
  modelProvider?: string | null
  path?: string | null
      // [UNSTABLE] Specify the rollout path to resume from. If specified for a non-running thread, the thread_id param will be ignored. If thread_id identifies a running thread, the path must match the active rollout path.
  permissions?: string | null
      // Named profile id for the resumed thread. Cannot be combined with `sandbox`.
  personality?: Personality | null
      // @deprecated `friendly` and `pragmatic` no longer select a style. Changing this does not rewrite the thread's existing instructions.
  runtimeWorkspaceRoots?: Array<AbsolutePathBuf> | null
      // Replace the thread's runtime workspace roots. Paths must be absolute.
  sandbox?: SandboxMode | null
  serviceTier?: string | null
  threadId: string

TurnStartParams
  additionalContext?: Record<string, AdditionalContextEntry> | null
      // Optional client-provided context fragments keyed by an opaque source identifier.
  approvalPolicy?: AskForApproval | null
      // Override the approval policy for this turn and subsequent turns.
  approvalsReviewer?: ApprovalsReviewer | null
      // Override where approval requests are routed for review on this turn and subsequent turns.
  clientUserMessageId?: string | null
  collaborationMode?: CollaborationMode | null
      // EXPERIMENTAL - Set a pre-set collaboration mode. Takes precedence over model, reasoning_effort, and developer instructions if set. For `collaboration_mode.settings.developer_instructions`, `null` means "use the built-in instructions for the selected mode".
  cwd?: string | null
      // Override the working directory for this turn and subsequent turns.
  cyberAccessProgram?: CyberAccessProgram | null
      // EXPERIMENTAL - Request an authorized cyber program for this turn. Omission preserves automatic behavior. This does not grant access.
  disabledPluginIds?: Array<string> | null
      // Replace this thread's disabled plugin IDs. Omitted/null preserves the list; [] clears it.
  effort?: ReasoningEffort | null
      // Override the reasoning effort for this turn and subsequent turns.
  environments?: Array<TurnEnvironmentParams> | null
      // Optional environments for this turn and subsequent turns. Omitted uses the thread sticky environments. Empty disables environment access for this turn. Non-empty selects the first environment as the current turn environment for this turn.
  input: Array<UserInput>
  model?: string | null
      // Override the model for this turn and subsequent turns.
  multiAgentMode?: MultiAgentMode | null
      // @deprecated Ignored. Use `effort: "ultra"` for proactive multi-agent behavior.
  outputSchema?: unknown
      // Optional JSON Schema used to constrain the final assistant message for this turn.
  parentTurnId?: string | null
      // ID of the turn that caused this new turn to start. Set this when starting work on behalf of another turn, such as delegated work in a different thread. Leave unset for work started directly by the user. Ignored when this request adds input to an active turn.
  permissions?: string | null
      // Select a named permissions profile id for this turn and subsequent turns. Cannot be combined with `sandboxPolicy`.
  personality?: Personality | null
      // @deprecated `friendly` and `pragmatic` no longer select a style. Changing this does not rewrite the thread's existing instructions.
  responsesapiClientMetadata?: Record<string, string> | null
      // Optional metadata to enrich Codex's ResponsesAPI turn metadata. Entries are flattened into the JSON string sent as `client_metadata["x-codex-turn-metadata"]` on ResponsesAPI HTTP and websocket requests. They are not sent as top-level ResponsesAPI `client_metadata` keys, and reserved keys such as `session_id`, `thread_id`, `turn_id`, and `window_id` cannot be overridden.
  rootTurnId?: string | null
      // ID of the first turn in the chain of work that led to this new turn. When setting `parentTurnId`, set this to the parent turn's `rootTurnId` when known. This keeps descendant work attributed to the original turn. If omitted, the new turn becomes its own root. Ignored when this request adds input to an active turn.
  runtimeWorkspaceRoots?: Array<AbsolutePathBuf> | null
      // Replace the thread's runtime workspace roots for this turn and subsequent turns. Paths must be absolute.
  sandboxPolicy?: SandboxPolicy | null
      // Override the sandbox policy for this turn and subsequent turns.
  serviceTier?: string | null
      // Override the service tier for this turn and subsequent turns.
  serviceTierForTurn?: string | null
      // Override the service tier only when this request starts a new turn. Use "default" for standard speed. Omitted or null inherits the thread's tier. Does not change the thread's tier or a turn being steered.
  summary?: ReasoningSummary | null
      // Override the reasoning summary for this turn and subsequent turns.
  threadId: string
  toolOutput?: TurnToolOutput | null
  turnTrigger?: string | null
      // Optional source classification for the caller that starts this turn. Ignored when this request steers an already-active turn.
